Use-case & requirements (customer language & AE notes):

- Secondary: legal/regulatory doc search + reranking for fraud cases.
- Latency target: p95 <= 400ms for short prompt flows, acceptable warm-cache p95 <= 200ms.
- Throughput: steady-state 20-40 RPS; burst 120 RPS for peak windows.
- Model preferences: open-models ok; interested in Redwood-managed variants if cost effective. Wants ability to fallback to cheaper model during heavy load.
- Data rules: customer data must remain in US region, retention controls required, encryption with KMS, SSO/SAML access for app teams.

- VP of ML (internal champion) left role end of Sep — unclear who will own this now. AE suspects lack of internal sponsor is the primary reason for silence.
- Security team opened a formal questionnaire (SEC-9072) and flagged a requirement for proof-of-concept in a VPC with attested audit logs — extra work on our side and a friction point.
